name: service
description: The service domain pack (E12, docs/decisions/011): ordinary request-driven services, the concrete test of the pipeline-core/domain-pack split E13 extracted. This first landing (docs/decisions/016) is deliberately the smallest honest slice, not the full epic: only the three lenses the ADR names as reused UNCHANGED from the genai pack (tracing, ops, pii-governance) are declared here, proven to run against real service-domain points with zero SKILL.md edits. telemetry-cost (adapted, not reused), slo and dependency (new) all need genuine new skill content -- burn-rate derivation, error-budget policy, dependency-criticality rules -- and are explicit follow-up work, not attempted here. Same posture for the anti-redundancy gate (auto_instrumentation_baseline is declared below but no gate reads it yet) and for db_query/queue_producer/queue_consumer/scheduled_job/http_server_route S1 detection (all declared_undetected -- no registry or adapter pass produces them yet). declarative_route and http_client_call are the one real exception: E11-TS's TypeScript adapter already emits both via fixed passes (SP12, docs/decisions/013), previously undetected by any loaded pack (docs/decisions/014's own named gap) -- declaring them here is what makes those already-detected points visible to S3's gap model for the first time.

covered_signals.caveat: Only when the framework's own router exposes a low-cardinality template to the instrumentation library -- a raw/untemplated path (e.g. AEM resolving a URL to a content path by resource type) is not covered and needs the pack's own cardinality_guard design, not this baseline.
Conditionally required ("if request has ended with an error") on the HTTP duration histograms, per docs/decisions/012 finding 6 -- not present on every data point, only error ones.
